verdict.rationale: ReadMe is built on OpenAPI: it ingests OAS files to generate the API reference, and its MCP server gives AI coding assistants a live connection to the API spec. Docs files can also be exported from the Branch menu or via the ReadMe API, but none of the evidence explicitly says a reader can download the published OpenAPI definition. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented spec download/export for end users, confirmation that the export includes the OpenAPI file, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
